profile.name: 树莓派相机模块
profile.description: 一款用于树莓派平台的小型数字相机模块，可进行实时视频采集和静态图像获取。适合实验室中的显微成像、样品观察、装置监视和基础视觉记录等场景。
profile.description_en: A compact digital camera module for the Raspberry Pi platform, used for live video acquisition and still image capture. It is suitable for laboratory microscopy imaging, sample observation, instrument monitoring, and general visual documentation.

registry.name: Raspberry Pi Foundation Camera Pi Cam
registry.description: Camera PI CAM是由Raspberry Pi Foundation生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括停止、关闭、启动、打开、日志记录。支持Signal, Slot, getLast等操作。
